subject: Acme Health - request for prolonged log & backup retention for clinical audit
messages:
From: Maya Thompson <maya.thompson@acmehealth.com>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: acme-compliance@acmehealth.com
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: extended log/backup retention (clinical audit)

Hi Lauren,

Hope you9re well. We9re preparing for a multi-site clinical audit that will require us to show conversation logs and related backup snapshots going back 12 months. Our standard contract with vendors requires 12-18 months of recoverable logs for audit purposes; your default retention appears to be 90 days.

Can Redwood offer the following for Acme Health (pilot cohort only):
- Extend conversation and request/response logs retention to 12 months (secure, encrypted storage)
- Ensure backup snapshots relevant to flagged patient records are excluded from routine purge while on legal hold
- Confirm any cross-border transfer implications (some sites are EU/UK)

I attached a short PDF listing the audit requirements (audit_requirements.pdf). Please let me know what paperwork/legal changes you9d need (DPA addendum, SOC statement, etc.) and an estimated timeline. We9d like to keep this scoped to our tenant; if you need Dedicated or a private connector to meet the requirement, call that out.

Thanks,
Maya Thompson
Sr. Compliance Manager | Acme Health
maya.thompson@acmehealth.com

From: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, hannah_schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>, jonas_weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Maya Thompson <maya.thompson@acmehealth.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Request: extended log/backup retention (clinical audit)

Team,

Forwarding Acme9s request. Key asks: 12-month log retention, backup snapshots excluded from purge during legal hold, and clarity on cross-border transfers for EU/UK workloads. They called this a pilot cohort only. I attached a short machine-readable brief that maps their bullet points to our product capabilities (acme-request-brief.json).

Questions I need help with for the reply to Acme:
1) Legal: what DPA addendum language is required to support a 12-month retention carveout? Is there an easy opt-in clause or do we need a full amendment?
2) Security/Infra: can we tag backups and exclude snapshots from scheduled purge by tenant + tag? What about persistence costs and encryption-at-rest scope?
3) Product/Deployments: is this doable on Hosted, or do we need to propose Dedicated/Private for guaranteed data residency and retention control?

Target: propose a written approach + draft DPA addendum to send them by EOD tomorrow so they can circulate internally.

LMK availability for a 30-min sync today.

Thanks,
Lauren Bishop
Head of Sales, Enterprise Accounts | Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.ai

>> Attachment: acme-request-brief.json (2.1 KB)

From: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, hannah_schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>, jonas_weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 13:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: extended log/backup retention (clinical audit)

Lauren / team,

Quick legal read: we can support a 12-month retention carveout but it requires a DPA addendum that explicitly:
- Defines the scope (tenant IDs, resource tags, and legal-hold identifiers)
- Specifies access controls and encryption standards for archived logs
- Limits the carveout to the named Acme pilot cohort and permits automatic reversion once the pilot ends

Operationally, two options:
A) Hosted with addendum + feature flag: keep everything on Redwood9s hosted infrastructure, create a tagged "audit-archive" retention class. We need: retention SLA, cost pass-through language, and an audit trail requirement. This is fastest but introduces cross-border transfer complexity for EU data (we must ensure SCCs + TOC compliance; see note below).
B) Dedicated/Private: propose Dedicated pool in their chosen region(s) or Private deployment to avoid transfer risk. This is preferred for PHI-heavy workflows; longer lead time and a reserved-capacity commitment.

Cross-border transfers: if logs contain personal data for EU/UK residents, we need to include standard contractual clauses (SCCs) in the DPA addendum and call out subprocessors. We must also confirm with infra if keys for archived snapshots can be customer-managed (KMS) — that mitigates some transfer risk.

I drafted a starting addendum (DPA_addendum_v1.docx). I9ve flagged the clauses we will likely negotiate (cost, revert date, audit access).

Propose we send Acme a short, plain-language one-pager with the two options and recommended next steps. I can iterate the legal language after product confirms feasibility.

-Kim
Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Privacy & Contracts | Redwood Inference

>> Attachment: DPA_addendum_v1.docx (46 KB)

From: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Maya Thompson <maya.thompson@acmehealth.com>
Cc: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, hannah_schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>, jonas_weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: extended log/backup retention (clinical audit)

Maya,

Thanks for the clear ask and the appendix. We9ve reviewed internally and can propose a pragmatic path forward so Acme can meet the audit requirements while keeping options open for residency and cost. High level:

1) Proposed legal step (DPA addendum)
- We will provide a DPA addendum scoped to the pilot cohort that defines the retention carveout, audit access, and cost pass-through. Kim drafted a starter (attached). We9d expect a short negotiation cycle for the carveout period and revert terms.

2) Technical approach
- Hosted option (fastest): create a tenant-tagged encrypted archive class that retains conversation logs and related snapshots for 12 months. Snapshot exclusions from purge will be implemented via a legal-hold tag tied to the tenant + record IDs. Encryption-at-rest and access controls will follow our standard KMS model.
- Dedicated/Private (if Acme requires strict residency): we can propose Dedicated capacity in their preferred regions and offer customer-managed keys (KMS) to reduce transfer friction.

3) Cross-border & subprocessors
- For EU/UK personal data we will include the SCCs in the addendum and list subprocessors. If Acme requires HSM/KMS controls, that points to Dedicated/Private.

4) Timing & next steps
- Draft addendum + technical ops points: attached (DPA_addendum_draft.docx, backup-retention-ops-points.md).
- Request: please confirm which option you prefer (Hosted with addendum OR Dedicated/Private). If Hosted, we can turn on the audit-archive flag within 7-10 business days after the signed addendum. If Dedicated, timeline depends on capacity planning (estimate 6-8 weeks).
- We will use DocuSign for the addendum (link below).

DocuSign: https://docusign.com/AcmeHealth/Envelope/12345
Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/acme-retention-ops

If helpful, we can hop on a 30-min call tomorrow to walk through the options and the draft language.

Best,
Lauren Bishop
Head of Sales, Enterprise Accounts | Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.ai

>> Attachments: DPA_addendum_draft.docx (48 KB), backup-retention-ops-points.md (6 KB)
